name: alvins-club
description: Alvin's Club plugins: Social (AI social media manager), Channel and SEO & GEO. Each plugin bundles a skill and a hosted MCP connector with OAuth sign-in.

plugins.name: brandpilot
plugins.description: Social: AI social media manager. Plans, drafts and publishes posts for a person or a brand across X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram and Hashnode from one brief.

plugins.name: alvins-club-channel
plugins.description: Decide what to post next from your own results: analyze what worked, draft platform-specific captions and publish with your approval.

plugins.name: alvins-club-seo
plugins.description: SEO audit and AI visibility check for your own website, Search Console reports, keyword opportunities and article draft approval.
